contract.title: Wave A: search-ranking-evidence.ts DeterministicRankingEvidenceV1 parser
contract.invariant: DeterministicRankingEvidenceV1 (schema search_ranking_evidence_v1) parses only post-admission, pre-residual evidence with exact keys; provider fields never appear; canonical round-trip. No central runtime file changes in Wave A.
interface_changes: packages/mcp/src/core/search-ranking-evidence.ts (new file; DeterministicRankingEvidenceV1 parser/types per §5.1: candidateId, baselineScore=preRerankBaselineScore, retrieval stage ranks + per-pass RRF contributions, candidate, query groups)
security_boundaries: Evidence cannot be built before admission or with provider fields: timing and exact-key constraints are enforced (§7.6 A2 RED row parses_only_post_admission_pre_residual_evidence)
overlap_with: B4 (Wave B): deterministic evidence assembler requires A2 (and A4, B2, B3)
A4: feature vector is built from deterministic evidence only (§5.1)
contract.instructions: Create packages/mcp/src/core/search-ranking-evidence.ts (new file) with DeterministicRankingEvidenceV1 (schema search_ranking_evidence_v1) per §5.1: available after eligibility, pre-rerank baseline scoring, and the immutable admission snapshot, but before residual scoring or any provider request/application. §7.6 A2 RED row: test 'parses_only_post_admission_pre_residual_evidence'; expected failure: evidence can be built before admission or include provider fields; minimal passing: timing and exact-key constraints enforced. The residual feature vector is built from deterministic evidence only. Baseline identity anchor SEARCH_CANDIDATE_FINAL_SCORE_POLICY_ID (search-ranking-policy.ts:22) and computeSearchCandidateFinalScore (:392, consumed by scripts/satori-search-candidate-replay.mjs at :908/:1827) must not change behavior. Focused command is plan-specified (§7.5 A2 row) and targets a test file absent at round_base: unverifiable-at-base. Affected command pnpm --filter @zokizuan/satori-mcp test is repo-verified (packages/mcp/package.json 'test' script; .github/workflows/ci.yml:150) and must pass.
